description: This file contains unit tests for the Apache OFBiz framework's base utilities, specifically testing debugging, credit card formatting, number validation, and utility functions.

classes.name: BaseUnitTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing utility functions and debugging features within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testDebug
methods.description: Tests the Debug utility class's get and set methods and verifies verbose and info modes.

methods.name: testFormatPrintableCreditCard1
methods.description: Tests formatting of a full credit card number into a masked version.

methods.name: testFormatPrintableCreditCard2
methods.description: Tests formatting of a short credit card number.

methods.name: testIsDouble1
methods.description: Verifies that a decimal number string is correctly identified as not a double when bounds are strict.

methods.name: testIsFloat1
methods.description: Verifies that a decimal number string is correctly identified as not a float when bounds are strict.

methods.name: testIsDouble2
methods.description: Verifies that a precise decimal number string is recognized as a double.

methods.name: testIsFloat2
methods.description: Verifies that a precise decimal number string is recognized as a float.

methods.name: testStringUtil
methods.description: Tests conversion of byte array to hex string and back, ensuring round-trip integrity.
